title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Require users to enter a more detailed description when posting a journal line of type G/L Account (Omit Default Descr. in Jnl.)
summary: The Omit Default Descr. in Jnl. field on G/L Account cards forces users to enter custom descriptions for journal lines instead of auto-filling with the account's default description. When this option is enabled, posting fails if the description field is left blank, improving audit trail quality.
key_points: Enable 'Omit Default Descr. in Jnl.' on the G/L Account Card to prevent automatic description insertion
Users must manually enter a description for journal lines when this setting is active
System validation requires all description fields to be filled before posting journal lines
Descriptions are stored in G/L entries for audit trail purposes
This is a Netherlands localization feature also available in W1 version
features: Omit Default Descr. in Jnl. field
